en.headline: West Kowloon Picnic Fest opens for four weekends by the harbour
en.dek: The first edition runs from today until 11 October on the Art Park waterfront lawn, with food market stalls, live music, workshops and picnic gear rental.
body: West Kowloon Cultural District has launched its inaugural Picnic Fest, running over four consecutive weekends and public holidays from 18 September to 11 October on the Art Park East Lawn by the harbour.

The event features a specialty food market, live music and street performances, themed workshops, and the district’s first picnic equipment rental service. Sixteen on-site restaurants and cafés are offering limited-time picnic set menus. Visitors who buy a designated set can borrow two folding chairs free on the same day.

Rental items available at the visitor information station include folding chairs, children’s chairs, picnic mats, outdoor fans and picnic lights, priced from HK$40 to HK$50. A Bike & Picnic Pass combines bicycle hire, a picnic set and workshop access. Opening hours are generally 2 pm to 9 pm, with adjusted hours on National Day.

West Kowloon Cultural District Authority chief executive Betty Fung said the festival aims to let visitors explore the cultural district in a relaxed way. The programme coincides with Mid-Autumn Festival and the National Day holiday period.

zh.headline: 西九首辦野餐節 一連四個周末及假期舉行
zh.dek: 西九文化區藝術公園海濱東草坪由今日起至10月11日舉行野餐節，設美食市集、音樂表演、工作坊及野餐用品租借。
body: 西九文化區首次舉辦「西九野餐節」，由9月18日至10月11日，逢周末及公眾假期在藝術公園海濱東草坪舉行。
活動設有特色美食市集、現場音樂及街頭表演、主題工作坊，以及園區首次推出的野餐用品租借服務。區內16間餐飲商戶同步推出野餐主題限定套餐，購買指定套餐的訪客當日可免費租借兩張摺疊椅。
訪客資訊站提供摺疊野餐椅、兒童椅、野餐墊、戶外風扇及野餐燈等租借，租金由40至50元。另有「單車野餐套票」結合單車、野餐及工作坊體驗。開放時間一般為下午2時至晚上9時，國慶日稍作調整。
西九文化區管理局行政總裁馮程淑儀表示，希望透過野餐節讓訪客以輕鬆寫意的方式探索文化區。活動適逢中秋及國慶長假期。
